messages:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-411 resolved at 14:12 UTC. Root cause: degraded KV cache eviction under burst traffic. Docs and timeline will be captured. Please schedule a postmortem and assign a facilitator. Tags: #customer-impact, #sev2 :white_check_mark:
marta: I can own scheduling. Need someone to facilitate and someone to write the postmortem. Who can take facil? @chris @jun ?
chris: I can facilitate, happy to. Will need someone to take notes / write up (I can draft the timeline).
jun: I can take notes + collect logs and SLO graphs. Can we aim for tomorrow 15:00 UTC or Friday 09:00 PT? Need to include sales/CS rep for impacted customer follow-up.
sara: Friday 09:00 PT works for me. I can loop in @paul (customer success) and he can speak to customer impact.
paul: I can join Friday and give the customer timeline and any outstanding asks. Do we have a short agenda?
marta: Proposed agenda: 1) quick timeline (5m) 2) what broke (10m) 3) mitigations and why (10m) 4) customer impact and comms (10m) 5) action items and owners (15m). Total 50m. OK? :calendar:
chris: Sounds good. I'll run the meeting and keep to the agenda. Can someone add the calendar event and include the incident binder + logs link?
jun: Adding logs and dashboards here: https://internal-redwood/incs/1782003456/logs (private). Also attaching KV cache eviction grafana snapshot in the doc.
sara: I'll add Paul and the sales rep to the invite. Please include the runbook section about cache eviction so we can review mitigation fidelity.
marta: Assigning roles: Facilitator: chris, Scribe: jun, Note owner: chris/jun to produce the draft postmortem, Customer rep: paul, Ops reviewer: sara.
chris: I'll create the calendar invite now. Draft invite: "Postmortem: INC-2026-411 — KV cache eviction under burst" with link to incident binder + agenda + zoom link. Anyone object to Friday 09:00 PT?
paul: No objections. Confirmed.
jun: Quick ask — can we add an explicit action item to validate the autoscaler thresholds and to add soak tests? I want that tracked now.
marta: Yes. Action items to add to tracker: 1) validate autoscaler thresholds (owner: eng-infra, due: 2 weeks) 2) add soak test for sustained burst (owner: eng-runtime, due: 3 weeks) 3) postmortem write-up and publish (owner: chris/jun, due: 5 business days).
chris: I'll create the postmortem PR after the meeting and assign to the list. Can we also do a quick RFC for fallback policy changes if cache eviction starts to happen?
sara: Agreed, RFC helpful. I'll put a stub in the RFC board referencing this incident.
ops-bot: Reminder set: postmortem scheduled for 2026-03-20 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to participants.
paul: Confirmed on calendar. I'll prep customer notes and potential comms.
marta: Thanks everyone. Action: please add any other attendees to the calendar, and add any logs/queries you'll want reviewed to the incident binder before EOD. I'll run the attendee checklist and post a final invite with Zoom + docs. :thumbsup:
chris: Thanks — I'll prep the facilitation checklist and the timeline slides.
jun: I'll upload the extracted traces and the eviction heatmaps to the binder before the meeting.
sara: Putting an immediate blocking action: ops-sre to validate rollout rollback path and add a short playbook fragment. I'll PR that by tomorrow.
marta: Closing thread — see calendar invite. Follow-ups will be tracked in the incident tracker (link in invite).
